description: Combining value (book-to-market) with 12-month momentum skipping the most recent month targets the value-momentum negative correlation documented by Asness et al. (2013); if the combined portfolio fails to outperform either standalone factor after transaction costs, the diversification benefit is falsified.
title: Value-Momentum Combo 12M/1M Skip 1M · Top 50 · Top 1000 · Long Only
